t: A 60 minute unplugged lesson where students program a human robot to stack cups.
steps: Find My Robotic Friends in CS Fundamentals Course E, Lesson 1, on the Code.org site.
Print the symbol key for each group.
Print the stacking ideas sheet for each group.
Gather 10 disposable cups per group or print paper trapezoid templates.
Place students in groups of four and split each group into pairs.
Hold the class discussion and journal at the end.
